page.overview:
Who is Memara?

She seems to be a pleasant person, both in appearance and personality. However, she seems very strong-minded, never letting anything stand between herself and her goals. She was also willing to do anything that did not violate the Three Oaths., Memara}}

Memara is very weak in the One Power, with a strength level of . This is marginally above Siuan Sanche's strength after she was healed from Severing.

Memara was sent by Alviarin to Queen Tenobia in Saldaea as her personal advisor; her real purpose was to keep the queen under control and lessen Davram Bashere's influence on her, but Memara failed and was unsuccessful in both; she was left behind when Tenobia went to meet the other Borderland rulers.

Elaida intended to have Tenobia kidnapped and brought to the White Tower as King Alsalam and King Mattin Stepaneos; Likely Memara was initially part of this plan.
